% Known-bad page-break glue: old-style workspace \vspace{5cm} OUTSIDE any
% minipage. LaTeX discards that glue when it falls at a page break, so on a
% multi-page sheet the bottom-of-page problems print with zero cm to work in.
% The floor check alone cannot see this (5cm is declared) — the static
% outside-a-minipage rule must flag it.
\documentclass{article}
\newcounter{prob}
\newcommand{\problem}[1]{\stepcounter{prob}\vspace{0.4cm}\noindent\textbf{\theprob.}\quad #1}
\begin{document}
\problem{Solve for $x$: $2x + 3 = 11$.}
\vspace{5cm}
\problem{Solve for $x$: $x^2 - 9 = 0$.}
\vspace{5cm}
\end{document}
